Cooper Flagg scored the Mavericks' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 16 times in 69 starts, or 23% of the games they started. Max Christie was next with 15. The Mavericks made the game's first field goal in 42% of their 81 games and won 36% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
